lessonPractice.title: 官网准备展示客户 Logo 和“10 万团队在用”，但目前只有估算数字，部分 Logo 也没有展示授权。应该怎样处理？

options.label: 只展示已授权素材和可核验数据，并注明时间、口径与来源
options.feedback: 社会证明的价值来自外部可信依据，授权和统计说明让访客知道证据代表什么。

options.label: 先放知名客户 Logo 增加信任，等官网上线后再集中申请授权
options.feedback: 未经授权的标识不能作为可信证据，先展示还会带来品牌和事实风险。

options.label: 把估算数字取整成“10 万+”，只要视觉上足够醒目就不写来源
options.feedback: 无法说明统计对象、时间和来源的数字不能被核验，醒目反而会放大可信度问题。

en.title: A site wants customer logos and Used by 100,000 teams, but the count is estimated and some logos lack display permission. What should happen?

options.label: Show only authorized assets and verifiable data, with date, definition, and source
options.feedback: Social proof derives value from credible external evidence. Permission and measurement notes explain what that evidence represents.

options.label: Publish recognizable customer logos first and request permission after the site launches
options.feedback: Unauthorized marks cannot serve as trustworthy evidence, and publishing first creates brand and factual risk.

options.label: Round the estimate to 100,000+ and omit its source as long as the number looks prominent
options.feedback: A number without audience, time, or source cannot be verified, and prominence amplifies the credibility problem.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请审查官网社会证明：列出每个客户 Logo 的授权状态，数字补充统计对象、时间和来源，无法核验的内容先移除。不要自动改色或编造引述；最终只保留能提供证据的客户、评价和数据。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Audit the site's social proof: record permission status for every customer logo and add audience, date, and source to each metric. Remove anything unverifiable, do not recolor marks or invent quotes, and keep only evidence-backed customers, reviews, and data.
